known_coverage_gaps.why_uncovered: SAST tools (Bandit) pattern-match known-dangerous constructs; they cannot evaluate whether an authorization check is logically correct.
Requires reasoning about concurrent execution order, not static pattern matching. None of the tools here detect this class.

known_coverage_gaps.category: MCP-specific trust-boundary risks (tool poisoning, rug-pull updates)
known_coverage_gaps.why_uncovered: A recognized 2025-2026 attack category (OWASP MCP Tool Poisoning; CVE-2025-54136) with no mature free static scanner yet. Needs manual review of atlas/mcp/server.py's trust boundary, not a tool run.

known_coverage_gaps.category: PII in TESSERA ticket free-text fields
known_coverage_gaps.why_uncovered: Presidio (if run) scans SOURCE CODE here, not the ticket database's actual free-text content (comments, repro_steps, environment, description) -- which is where real PII risk in this project would actually live. Needs a separate pass against a DB export.
Already documented in this project's own literature review as a known recurring pattern. No tool here checks whether a passing test could ever actually fail.
